q1_issues.issue: "The Council recorded the night" makes the night a Patient, but the instruction set lists record among the verbs that merely evaluate or record an object and leave it as it was, which take Theme.

(Result sk_record_1 sk_ece_1) asserts the recording caused the night to be an extreme cold event; recording classifies rather than causes, and the guidance is to omit Result whenever a state is not caused by the verb.
The flat (Member sk_night_1 extreme_cold_event) asserts the Council's classification as a top-level fact, the same over-commitment the reported-attitude rule forbids for "is considered to be P".
"went out despite the salt-bloom" has a nominal complement, but the second argument of Despite is the reified hold event sk_hold_1 rather than the salt-bloom the words actually name.

The group-level hold event (32-35) drops "in their mire-essence" entirely: the oblique and the possessive "their" appear only inside the distribution rule at 36, so no top-level atom records the stated PP.
"four weeks of supply" is stored with the scale duration, which no word in the clause supplies; Measures & units reserves unspecified for a dimension no word states.
The per-member go_out rule omits the (TimeAtMost sk_go_out_1 dawn) bound carried by the group event at 28, so each distributed event loses the stated time bound.
(Ordinal sk_snap_1 2 cold_snap) puts a kind in the scale slot, whereas the Ordinal form's scale is the associated event lemma or an explicit -est dimension.

"had used" is a past perfect and the passage supplies an asserted event for it to precede (the reporting at 54-57), yet no (Before ...) ordering atom is emitted; arguable, since the rule's test is worded over the sentence but its exemption is worded over the text.

q2_gaps: "V NP as NP" predicative complement of a classifying / reporting verb ("recorded the night as an extreme cold event") — neither the resultative, depictive, change-of-kind nor attitude sections cover it, and nothing says whether the ascribed classification may be asserted of the object.
A concessive preposition with a nominal complement ("went out despite the salt-bloom") — the connective section requires two reified eventualities as endpoints and gives no form for despite + NP.
A measure-of / quantity partitive ("four weeks of supply"); "a cup of water" is named only to exclude it from Possession, and no encoding is specified.

A day-part time expression later referred to as an entity ("that night" as the Time constant night, then "the night" as a direct object with its own witness) — nothing links the bare time constant to the entity witness.

An ordinal day-of-year date in a non-Gregorian calendar ("On day 131 of Year 1") — (Day n) is defined as a day-of-month term composing with Month/Year, with no form for a day number counted within a year.
notes: The copular-with-time-modifier dual-emit, the "that night" term propagation, the phrasal verb go_out, the Cliff Path name plus entity-attached On, the sealed non-factive report with projected definite typing, and the mass partitive for "half of the autumn feather store" all match the instruction set exactly.
